scheme_name: Scheme to Provide Assistance to Sate Market Committees as well as Taluka-District Co-operative Purchase and Sale Union to Construct Large Size Warehouse Godowns
other_conditions: All State Market Committees in Gujarat are eligible to apply
Godowns must be used exclusively for the storage of farmers' produce
benefits_summary: Up to ₹6,500 per metric ton (maximum 50% of project cost) for large‑size warehouse godowns up to 5,000 MT
